visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman sits on a beige couch in a brightly lit room with a colorful geometric painting on the wall. She holds a tablet with a 'RIPNDIP' cat sticker. An inset video shows her in a green bodysuit wielding a wooden club against a blue background with 'SOD' text. (2) The camera zooms in as the woman laughs heartily, looking up with a wide smile and closed eyes. (3) She holds up a pile of dark, floral-patterned fabrics, looking directly at the camera with a skeptical expression. (4) A rapid montage sequence begins: the woman appears in a green full-body suit running in an outdoor brick alley, then in a blue dress with a long red wig posing against vibrant colored backgrounds. (5) She is seen in a plaid shirt and glasses laying on a yellow bed, then dancing and performing dramatic gestures in the blue dress. Bold, colorful text overlays flash across the screen. (6) The woman in the green suit stands on a busy city sidewalk holding a cardboard sign that says '我不是 HOW 哥' (I am not HOW-ge) as people walk by. (7) Final shot shows her in the green suit running away down the brick alleyway, viewed through a digital 'REC' viewfinder overlay with a battery icon.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male vocals rap 'SOD' over a heavy electronic beat with synthesized bass. (2) Music volume dips slightly as a female voice laughs heartily and speaks in a casual, high-arousal tone. (3) A series of metallic 'whoosh' sounds and sharp percussive hits trigger each visual cut. The BGM returns to full volume with a repetitive, rhythmic pop-rap melody. (4) The audio transitions to a mix of outdoor ambient noise floor, featuring distant traffic hum and the audible sound of the speaker's heavy breathing and running. (5) A final stinger sound effect plays as the music cuts abruptly, ending on the outdoor ambience.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Reaction -> Promotional Performance -> Humorous Coda.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To humorously promote the mobile game 'Dragon Soul' (龍魂旅人) by showing the creator's embarrassed reaction to her own over-the-top, cosplay-filled advertisement, leveraging a self-deprecating 'cringe' aesthetic to engage the audience.
